  RootPackage
    @CLayout
  struct NativeHandles
    field flag: UInt8
    field pin: PinnedPtr<Any>
    field handle: GcHandle<Any>
    @Extern(name = "exchange_handles")
  fun exchangeHandles(value: NativeHandles, pointer: Ptr<GcHandle<Any>>, callback: FunPtr<(GcHandle<Any>) -> GcHandle<Any>>?): NativeHandles
    @Extern(name = "native_handle")
    @Global
  var nativeHandle: GcHandle<Any>
    @NoGC
  fun echoHandle(value: GcHandle<Any>): GcHandle<Any>
    =
      Var value
  fun main()
    @Unsafe block
      val handle
        Call GcHandle<Any>
          IntLiteral 1uL
      val pin
        Call PinnedPtr<Any>
          IntLiteral 2uL
      val callback: FunPtr<(GcHandle<Any>) -> GcHandle<Any>>
        CallableReference 0 echoHandle
      val optional: FunPtr<(GcHandle<Any>) -> GcHandle<Any>>?
        Call Some
          Var callback
      val result
        Call exchangeHandles
          Call NativeHandles
            IntLiteral 3u
            Var pin
            Var handle
          Call addressOf<GcHandle<Any>>
            Var handle
          Var optional
      assign nativeHandle
        FieldAccess handle
          Var result
